name: CORD: Consolidated Receipt Dataset for Post-OCR Parsing
description: A consolidated receipt dataset for post-OCR parsing and information extraction introduced by NAVER Clova AI. Consists of 1,000 real-world receipts in Indonesian with extreme layout, font, distortion, and lighting variations. Annotations define 30 fine-grained semantic category labels organized across a 4-tier hierarchy (menu, total, subtotal, void) for bounding boxes, text transcriptions, and key-value pairings.
